scope: Exposure-weighted predictor geometry on every original quadrature node for each LOCO training wing. No supplementary model fitting or accuracy estimation performed by this analysis.

feature_definitions.s: Years from own estimated 15-degree crossing; held-out clock conditional on its own observations.
feature_definitions.log_area_amplitude: Natural log of same-wing full-cycle retrospective smoothed peak area summary.

weighting: Tensor-product trapezoid weights. Each wing has 1020 degree-years of domain exposure. Equivalent to node-centered midpoint/Voronoi cell areas including half-width edge cells.
VIF_method: For each centered standardized predictor, regress linearly on all other predictors using its exposure-weighted correlation matrix; VIF=1/(1-R_squared). Residual variance below 1e-10 is classified as infinite.
rank_method: Number of standardized correlation eigenvalues greater than 1e-10. Condition number is square root of largest/smallest eigenvalue for full-rank bases.

wing_level_area_description.interpretation: Descriptive only; hemisphere is not a supplementary predictive feature. Event counts are outcomes, never features. No p-values or independent-wing inference.

limitations: Design rows are numerical quadrature coordinates, not independent solar realizations.
Raw-coordinate correlations are zero by Cartesian construction, not evidence that observed latitude and time are independent.
VIF diagnoses linear feature redundancy; deterministic nonlinear dependence can remain.
No significance p-values, causal effects, or model-ranking conclusions follow from these feature diagnostics.
Nine development cycles are the cycle-level replication count; three sealed cycles are untouched.
supplementary_configuration_note: Configurations copied from the frozen benchmark manifest for documentation only; this analysis reads no supplementary accuracy results.
